item.title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options

turns.text: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage.

item.tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

answer_sheet.Exact wording: Moss & Mile on every option, including the ampersand; no extra text.
answer_sheet.Number and delivery: Three separate square images, not one collage or contact sheet.
answer_sheet.Style and palette: Simple cycling-club logos using green and black on white.
answer_sheet.How different the options should be: Three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts, not just recolors of one design.

must_haves: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.

style.prompt: Create ONE polished minimalist cycling club logo on a pure white square canvas. Exact lettering: "Moss & Mile" clearly spelled, and no other text. Green (#287345) and black only on white. Concept: a small circular bicycle wheel symbol whose upper-left arc turns into a delicate but very simplified fern frond, combining mossy nature with cycling. Small symbol centered above the club name, clean black modern sans-serif typography, generous white space, balanced professional vector-like flat logo design. Keep symbol simple, restrained and readable at small sizes. No mockup, no photographic elements, no gradients, no shadows, no border. One logo only, not a collage or presentation sheet.

Create ONE polished minimalist logo for cycling club "Moss & Mile" with that exact name and no other text. Pure white square canvas, green (#287345) and black ink only. Distinct concept: a small abstract winding road/ribbon drawn in green, making an elegant upright M shape with a tiny black dashed center line: a simple route emblem, NOT a bicycle or wheel or plant. Place the compact symbol centered above the name. Name in refined black bold lowercase-friendly geometric sans-serif typography, exact spelling "Moss & Mile". Highly simplified flat vector-style design with strong geometry and generous white space, professional cycling club identity. No gradients, no shadow, no mockup, no border. Only one logo on the image, not a collage.

Design ONE professional minimalist cycling club logo on a pure white square canvas. Exact text "Moss & Mile" and no other words. Green (#287345) and black only. Unique concept: two small stylized acorns side by side, slightly leaning toward one another, one green and one black, their stems forming a subtle connecting arch: a symbol of outdoor companionship and riding together. Acorns must be extremely simple geometric silhouettes with clear caps, no detailed illustration. NOT wheels, bicycles, roads, mountains or fern motifs. Small acorn emblem centered above the club name in a tasteful sturdy black serif typeface with warm editorial character. Minimal flat vector-like logo, carefully balanced, ample white space, crisp legible lettering. No gradients, no shadows, no mockup, no border, no collage, just one logo.
